# POSINEXT

> POSINEXT is restaurant POS software for fine dine restaurants, quick service restaurants (QSR) and cloud kitchens in India: billing, KOT, Table QR ordering, a captain app, kitchen display, online ordering website, app ordering, delivery app, Swiggy and Zomato integration and analytics on one connected platform.

POSINEXT runs on Windows at the outlet and supports offline operation for supported local workflows. Outlets connect to POSINEXT Cloud for online orders, backups and licences. Customers sign in at the customer portal to download apps, manage licences and open support tickets.

## Products

- [Fine Dine POS](https://posinext.com/fine-dine): table billing, live floor plan, KOTs to kitchen stations and split bills
- [QSR POS](https://posinext.com/qsr): counter billing with a photo menu, held bills and payment workflows
- [Table QR](https://posinext.com/table-qr): guests scan a table code to view the menu and place orders
- [Captain App](https://posinext.com/captain-app): waiters take orders at the table on a phone or tablet
- [Cloud Kitchen](https://posinext.com/cloud-kitchen): multiple brands and kitchen stations from one operation
- [Food Delivery App](https://posinext.com/food-delivery-app): the restaurant's own branded ordering app
- [Website Ordering](https://posinext.com/website-ordering): the restaurant's own ordering website
- [App Ordering](https://posinext.com/app-ordering): customers order from the restaurant's app
- [Swiggy & Zomato](https://posinext.com/swiggy-zomato): supported aggregator orders flow into the POS workflow
